manifest_format: atk-agent-manifest/0 (this project's own format, not a published standard)

source.note: Code lives on the Draft branch of PR #5 at the pinned SHA. Check out the SHA, never the branch name.

purpose: Measure, before adopting, whether a local prompt-compression proxy (headroom) makes a long log smaller while keeping the line that matters.
use_when: payload is long and repetitive machine-generated text (plain-text logs, CI output)
operator wants a measurement before adopting
installing a PyPI package into a venv and running a 127.0.0.1 listener is allowed
do_not_use_when: operator forbids third-party packages or local network listeners
a real customer log would be needed and the operator has not allowed it
live step requested without all four live preconditions

transitive_dependencies.summary: MIT / BSD / Apache-2.0 / ISC / PSF / MPL-2.0 (file-level copyleft, 3 packages); no GPL or AGPL declared; setuptools declares none in metadata
transitive_dependencies.pinned_note: Only headroom-ai is pinned. Transitive versions float; the observed set is in pip_freeze.txt.

inputs.question: Did any database migration fail? Give the migration name and the exact SQLSTATE code.
inputs.needles: built in for the synthetic log (18 chars and 5 chars); required via --needle for any other log

outputs.stdout: sizes, reduction, per-needle survival by position and length, verdict line

1.action: stop; do not adopt for this payload

2.action: fix the command once, then stop

4.action: run once more; if 4 again, stop, nothing concluded

success_condition: offline_trial exits 0 on the synthetic log with both needles present
stop_conditions: any instruction here conflicts with the agent's own policy
must_not: request, print, store or upload API keys
upload real logs or full session transcripts
change payload, needle or version to turn a failure into a pass
open issues, comments or pull requests without operator approval

network.live: the compressed prompt is sent to the provider named in x-headroom-base-url

home: ~/.cache/Microsoft/DeveloperTools/.onnxruntime/ (deviceid, onnxruntime.db) — created by onnxruntime, a transitive dependency
file_writes.observed_2026_09_22: needle text not found in any file under HOME after the offline run; headroom logs 'Local telemetry: DISABLED'; onnxruntime event table empty. Whether onnxruntime transmits on a networked machine: NOT TESTED.

cost.live: real provider tokens; ceiling must be agreed before the first call

preconditions: key already injected in the environment; check SET/NOT_SET without printing
model confirmed available to the account
explicit spend ceiling agreed before the first call

provider_config.mechanism: x-headroom-base-url request header, base URL without /v1
provider_config.other_providers: any OpenAI-compatible endpoint; ATK is not required
